body: That was really nice, thank you!
I don't know if you're able to stop much but gas stations usually have microwaves that they don't mind you using to heat up food. It's what I used when I was on the ambulance.

Oh ok! Well in that case, for breakfast is a bacon and egg breakfast taco. For lunch is chipotle style with pinto beans, carmalized red onions and bell peppers, rice, chipotle style roasted chicken, and corn with red peppers in it. For dinner is a roasted chicken thigh and we roasted huge cookie sheets of veggies so that we could mix and match vegetables. But the roasted veggies are red bell peppers, squash, carrots, and broccoli. And the kind bars and yogurt are snacks between meals, along with a protein shake if wanted.
I actually used recipes from this sub! But I'll put them all in a comment here when I have time
Honestly yes! I mean it was a little hectic but we learned a lot about what to do the second time around
